propositions: Prompt cache breakpoint placement after pass-specific stance suffix (not at shared-prefix boundary) causes zero cross-pass reads within a single run and zero re-review reads on same ticket within TTL, despite plan and shared prefix being byte-identical across those contexts.

Cache write operations are charged at premium rate on every plan-review call (9200-9450 tokens per review) and never read across calls (0 tokens), incurring pure loss of ~9k-11k premium-rate tokens per review for multi-pass single-ticket reviews.

The telemetry diagnostic warn_if_cache_ineffective detects only write==0 AND read==0 shape (passes below model floor), missing the write>0/read==0 pattern that occurs on all three writing passes (plan-reviewer, verifier, prerequisite-verifier), making cache waste invisible to observability.

Moving cache breakpoint to end of byte-stable shared_plan_prefix (via RunRequest.cache_prefix runner-seam to separate static system prompt from dynamic instructions) enables pass-1 finder write to be read by pass-2 verifier within same run and same-ticket re-review to read within TTL.
